records.label: Process permissive indication
records.description: A read-only or synthetic indication of whether the external control system reports the scoped process permissive as available, withheld, or removed.
records.provenance_consideration: The source must be identified as a controller indication and must not be represented as FacilityOps command authority or proof of physical effect.
records.limitations: No flagship point definition, observation, mapping, state vocabulary, or executable interpretation is approved in this package.

records.label: Process-enabled operating-context indication
records.description: A proposed read-only or synthetic indication that the external controller reports the scoped process as enabled, represented separately from permission to enable it.
records.provenance_consideration: The source must be identified as a controller-reported operating context; it may share a controller origin with request evidence and does not independently prove process operation.
records.limitations: This is a project-authored traceability category. No flagship point definition, observation, mapping, state vocabulary, or executable interpretation is approved in this package.

records.label: Particulate treatment availability
records.description: A category for a future indication that reports the common particulate treatment dependency available for the scoped operating context.
records.provenance_consideration: The bound point definition represents a permissive-indication category only; later provenance must distinguish treatment controller logic, device status, differential pressure, monitoring, and other physical evidence.
records.limitations: The point definition is not an observation baseline. A future permissive indication would not prove treatment operation, performance, condition, or suitability.

records.label: Supply or makeup-air controller-reported status
records.description: A category for the external controller's reported status of the supply or makeup-air dependency.
records.provenance_consideration: Controller-reported status and measured delivered response remain separate categories even when they are carried by the same system.
records.limitations: The bound point definition is not an observation baseline and a future status indication would not prove airflow, capacity, damper response, pressure contribution, or physical operation.

records.label: Supply or makeup-air delivered response
records.description: A separate category for future measured or otherwise controlled evidence of delivered supply or makeup-air response.
records.provenance_consideration: The measurement source, location, mapping, units, calibration, uncertainty, and independence from controller status must be retained.
records.limitations: No delivered-response point definition, observation, instrument, threshold, timing rule, or sufficiency rule is approved.

records.label: Duty-fan controller request
records.description: A read-only or synthetic indication that the external controller requests duty-fan operation.
records.provenance_consideration: The observation must retain controller-source identity and remain distinct from reported execution, device feedback, electrical response, and airflow.
records.limitations: FacilityOps does not issue the request, and the indication does not establish controller execution or fan operation.

records.label: Standby-fan controller request
records.description: A read-only or synthetic indication that the external controller requests standby-fan operation.
records.provenance_consideration: The observation must retain controller-source identity and remain distinct from reported execution, device feedback, electrical response, and airflow.
records.limitations: FacilityOps does not issue the request, and the indication does not establish successful changeover or fan operation.

records.label: Duty-fan controller-reported execution
records.description: An indication that the controller reports its duty-fan command or sequence action as issued or executed.
records.provenance_consideration: The source remains controller-side evidence and must not be treated as field-device receipt, actuation, motor response, airflow, or pressure response.
records.limitations: No point definition, observation, or controller semantic is selected, and controller-reported execution does not prove physical effect.

records.label: Standby-fan controller-reported execution
records.description: An indication that the controller reports its standby-fan command or sequence action as issued or executed.
records.provenance_consideration: The source remains controller-side evidence and must not be treated as field-device receipt, actuation, motor response, airflow, or pressure response.
records.limitations: No point definition, observation, or controller semantic is selected, and controller-reported execution does not prove physical effect.

records.label: Duty and standby fan availability indications
records.description: Bound point definitions for future reported availability indications for both members of the fan pair.
records.provenance_consideration: Availability source, calculation, inhibit, maintenance, override, and out-of-service semantics must be preserved before later inference.
records.limitations: Availability indication does not establish fan operation, capacity, successful start, or delivered airflow.

records.label: Duty and standby fan run-status indications
records.description: Bound point definitions for future reported run-status indications for both members of the fan pair.
records.provenance_consideration: The physical source of the run indication must be retained; a controller-derived run status is not independent motor or airflow evidence.
records.limitations: Run status alone does not establish rotation, delivered airflow, capacity, or pressure response.

records.label: Duty and standby VFD state and feedback
records.description: Partial point-definition representation for future VFD-side operating-state and speed feedback for each fan.
records.provenance_consideration: Later mapping must identify whether state and speed originate in the drive, controller, or a duplicated derived source.
records.limitations: Speed-feedback point definitions exist, but no baseline observations or dedicated VFD operating-state point definitions exist; neither a future speed indication nor VFD-state indication would prove motor response or airflow.

records.label: Duty and standby motor or electrical response
records.description: Motor current, power, contactor, drive-output, or another controlled electrical response category for each fan.
records.provenance_consideration: The physical measurement source and derivation must determine whether it is independent of controller and VFD indications.
records.limitations: No electrical point definition, observation, instrument, method, tolerance, or inference is approved; electrical response alone would not prove airflow.

records.label: Delivered process-exhaust airflow
records.description: A bound point definition for future measured or reported airflow evidence for the shared process-exhaust system.
records.provenance_consideration: Sensor identity, location, measurement method, mapping, units, calibration, uncertainty, and source independence must be retained.
records.limitations: The point definition is not an observation baseline; no threshold, sufficiency rule, sensor design, or physical validation is approved.

records.label: Shared exhaust-path indications
records.description: Bound point definitions for future duct-static and damper-position indications associated with the common exhaust path.
records.provenance_consideration: Damper command, position feedback, duct pressure, and airflow are different indications unless their source and derivation establish otherwise.
records.limitations: The point definitions are not observations and do not prove path integrity, treatment condition, fan capacity, or delivered exhaust performance.

records.label: Corridor-to-airlock and airlock-to-laboratory differential pressure
records.description: Bound point definitions for future differential-pressure indications across both directed boundaries in the intended cascade.
records.provenance_consideration: Port orientation, sign convention, sensor location, calibration, range, uncertainty, mapping, and timestamps must be controlled before inference.
records.limitations: The point definitions are not observations. No numerical pressure criterion, tolerance, persistence, hysteresis, or recovery interval is approved.

records.label: Process-laboratory zone-pressure indication
records.description: A bound point definition for a future reported process-laboratory zone-pressure indication with its reference basis to be defined later.
records.provenance_consideration: Reference pressure, port location, sign convention, calibration, uncertainty, mapping, and timing must be controlled.
records.limitations: The point definition is not an observation, and a future zone-pressure indication would not by itself establish either boundary relationship or containment.

records.label: Evidence health, identity, timing, and duplication context
records.description: Metadata needed to identify missing, stale, suspect, overridden, out-of-service, late, duplicated, or conflicting evidence.
records.provenance_consideration: Source-native identity, mapping version, event time, receive time, source sequence, quality, override, and derivation are required to judge evidence independence and sufficiency later.
records.limitations: Existing Northstar current-value health fields cover only part of this category and do not provide flagship baseline observations; duplicate, late, out-of-order, mapping-version, and independence semantics remain proposed for the next decision.

records.label: Post-action recovery observation set
records.description: New observations collected after a recorded human or external-controller action for a separate future recovery evaluation.
records.provenance_consideration: The set must preserve observation identity, timing, mapping, evidence health, and the relationship to the recorded action without treating the action as physical proof.
records.limitations: This is not a new recovery flag point; the future set must reuse or extend controlled observation categories under approved temporal and evaluation semantics.
